szoveg_eredeti:
We’re sharing updates on computer-use agents for healthcare workflows.
These advances could help reduce the administrative burden on healthcare teams, from navigating medical records to working across insurance portals and other software.

Here’s a demo of what computer use in healthcare looks like: a computer use agent works across clinical and insurance systems to prepare an MRI authorization request.

It gathers supporting documentation for clinician review, then prepares the authorization request for specialist review.

Healthcare organizations are already putting computer use to work.
 Abridge , Ambience Healthcare , Cigna Healthcare , and CVS Health are using our models to help streamline prior authorizations, referrals, discharge planning, and patient outreach.
